A shifted-position control yields about 10 chance matches per epoch against about 2,500 real ones. After archival radio vetting (FIRST/NVSS) and multi-archive characterization (Legacy DR10 host offsets, SDSS spectra, NEOWISE, ZTF light curves), we report 5 unclassified candidates (5 emergent, 0 fading) whose nuclear 3 GHz radio state changed within a window containing the optical event. The method blindly recovers both AT 2020aboe (AstroNote 2026-209) and the published repeating partial TDE AT 2020vdq as its top-ranked known objects. Spectroscopic and radio follow-up of the candidates is encouraged; all data products are available on request.
